summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the age contrast, weakness and poverty, exclusive expectation of death, sudden inheritance, posture contrasts, renewal from former deeds, singular and plural spirits, past actions, the Lord’s joy, and the whole-heart communal-peace condition for further disclosure. The simplified edition’s sentence divisions do not change these relationships. The notes accurately disclose the supplied reports’ variants, editorial supplements, correction layers, and mediated Ethiopic rendering without replacing the working readings or presenting them as identical witness agreement. The contextual speaker attribution is explicitly distinguished from the gender-neutral Greek verb. Acceptance is limited to the supplied text and evidence reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, certify editions, or establish exhaustive collation or a unique interpretation.
